#  11224 - Web-Based Collaborative Engineering and European Language Skills (except English) I Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11224 - module is no longer offered from WS 2024/25**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Web-Based Collaborative Engineering and European Language Skills (except English) I**  |  
|  Webbasierte Projektbearbeitung im Ingenieurwesen und europäische Sprachen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | 
  * understanding of Web-based collaborative engineering approaches in research and professional projects
  * practical experiences in Web-based collaborative engineering in a river modelling project 
  * distributed team work and team management skills using v"irtual environments" based on information sharing
  * basic skills in river modelling


  * European language skills.

 |  
| Contents:  | Introduction of Web-based collaboration and related working methods, central and distributed collaboration, synchronous and asynchronous collaboration, time management and time shift working; coordination, cooperation and competition; team management, documentation and reporting in engineering projects.Information exchange and information sharing. interaction agreements, version and access control, Web-based tools for conferencing (chat, audio, video), application sharing, web-based project platforms (CSWS), engineering reports based on the media paper and on the media Web.Team work exercise “HydroWeb”: teams from several partner universities are working on a river management project via Internet as independent units using Web technology to overcome the spatial distribution.German Language course, optional courses on other European languages except English.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | No successful participation in associated phase-out module _41418 Language Skills_.  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | see https://euroaquae.tu-cottbus.de  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Web-Based Collaborative Engineering: (2/3)
  * collaborative on-line team work and management evaluation by supervisor (40%)
  * web-based team reports and team presentations incl. discussion (30%)
  * individual questionnaire (30%)

Language course: (1/3)
  * examination by Language Centre

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | EuroAquae module: EA-1.5/6  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 019035 Course German as a Foreign Language (A1, Part 1 - Starter) 
  * 240635 Lecture/Practical training HydroWeb: Web-based Collaborative Engineering

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
